command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create opsadmin if missing =="
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
  echo "created opsadmin"
else
  echo "opsadmin already exists"
fi

echo "== set up .ssh =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
PUBKEY='ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid'
echo "$PUBKEY" | sudo -n tee /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys >/dev/null
sudo -n chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys

echo "== configure sshd for key-only auth =="
sudo -n tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
UsePAM yes
EOF

echo "== validate sshd config =="
sudo -n sshd -t

echo "== reload sshd =="
sudo -n systemctl reload sshd

echo "== verify =="
id opsadmin
cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
ls -ld /home/opsadmin/.ssh
ls -l /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n sshd -T | grep -Ei '^(passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|pubkeyauthentication)'

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== generate ephemeral test keypair =="
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /tmp/test_key -N '' -q
TESTPUB=$(cat /tmp/test_key.pub)
echo "== append ephemeral pubkey temporarily =="
sudo -n bash -c "echo '$TESTPUB' >> /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys"

echo "== attempt pubkey ssh login as opsadmin via NODE_IP =="
ssh -i /tmp/test_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'whoami; echo PUBKEY_AUTH_OK'

echo "== attempt password-only ssh login (should fail) =="
ssh -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 opsadmin@"$NODE_IP" 'echo SHOULD_NOT_SUCCEED' && echo "UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS" || echo "PASSWORD_AUTH_CORRECTLY_REJECTED"

echo "== cleanup: remove ephemeral key, keep only the required key =="
PUBKEY='ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid'
echo "$PUBKEY" | sudo -n tee /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys >/dev/null
sudo -n chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
rm -f /tmp/test_key /tmp/test_key.pub
echo "== final authorized_keys =="
cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
